card.name: Inside ALL-CAPS words before AL/EL/IL endings
card.fires_on: Partway through words written in capital letters, right before an ending such as -IL, -OL or -ALINE. It is most common on the NT of UNTIL and the ER of STERILE.

modes.label: UNTIL in capitals
modes.description: The NT in capitalised UNTIL, in a warning about withholding or stopping a drug.
modes.example: THIS PRODUCT SHOULD BE WITHHELD U<<NT>>IL APPROPRIATE CORRECTIVE

modes.label: STERILE in capitals
modes.description: The ER in capitalised STERILE, in handling instructions.
modes.example: DO NOT TOUCH THE ST<<ER>>ILE SYRINGE TIP

modes.label: Capitalised drug or chemical names
modes.description: The middle of capitalised names such as MISOPROSTOL, ALKALINE or ETHYL.
modes.example: UTERINE RUPTURE HAS BEEN REPORTED WHEN MISOPRO<<ST>>OL WAS ADMINISTERED

card.writes: It pushes the next piece toward letter groups starting with a capital L, such as AL, CL, EL and PL.
card.plain: It fires inside capitalised words like UNTIL, STERILE and MISOPROSTOL, just before the word ends.
